svg.aria-label: Subscription logins behind one API key: 1. Seed: An init container copies the OAuth files from Secret cliproxyapi-seed onto the PVC, only when a file of that name is missing. 2. Config: Secret cliproxyapi-config renders config.yaml with the client keys and the management key, mounted read-only at /config. 3. Serve: The app listens on port 8317. HTTPRoute cliproxyapi on envoy-internal is the only way in, and LiteLLM is the main caller. 4. Refresh: The app rewrites refreshed tokens into /data/auths on the 1 Gi ceph-block claim. After the first seed the Secret never overwrites them. 5. Back up: Kopiur snapshots the claim to the local Ceph pool every few hours and to R2 once a day, so a lost volume restores the logins.
